title: Visualize Runtime Executor
description: View the saved runtime snapshot as DOT + HTML without refreshing, with Goal vs Current when architecture/runtime-dependencies-goal.json exists. Refresh: pnpm nx run architecture:generate. Viewing never writes; --prepare-goal explicitly recomputes the goal's derived levels first.

prepareGoal.description: Recompute and save architecture/runtime-dependencies-goal.json's derived levels, self-queue flags, contract queues and maxLevel before viewing.
